|rulings=* Modifiers to 'Star Destroyers' apply twice (e.g. [[Admiral Motti]] V adds 4 power instead of 2 and +2 immunity instead of +1. [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe{{!}}The Ultimate Power In The Universe]] subtracts 4 from deploy instead of 2. Deployment modifiers on [[Kuat]] are doubled).<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Intimidator%20%26%20%E2%80%A2Persecutor Scomp: Intimidator & •Persecutor]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Responses to deploying a Star Destroyer only occur once (e.g. [[A Million Voices Crying Out]] retrieves 3, not 6).
* Works with actions that deploy/move one 'starship' but not cards that deploy/move one 'Star Destroyer' (e.g. cannot be deployed by [[Commander Nemet (V)]] or moved by [[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon{{!}}On The Verge Of Greatness]]).
* Works with other actions that target (not deploy/move) a Star Destroyer, such as [[Apology Accepted (V)]].
